item.title: Visualizing energy transfer across a hexagonal Cs 4 PbBr 6 microdisk using single-particle spectroscopy
item.description:
Authors: Soumik De, Mrinal Kanti Panda, Subhadip Ghosh

Spatial mapping of energy transfer in hexagonal Cs 4 PbBr 6 perovskite microdisks reveals enhanced core efficiency due to increased dye occupancy in structural cavities.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00287k

item.title: Electrospinning-based architectural engineering of multi-layered fibrous membranes with spatially defined wettability for solar desalination
item.description:
Authors: Dianming Li, Chuang Cheng, Yanxia Luo, Xi Yao, Libang Feng

A sequentially electrospun PAN–PS–PAN fibrous membrane with spatially defined wettability coordinates water transport and heat localization for efficient solar-driven interfacial evaporation.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00279j

item.title: The future of the Nanoscale journal family: connected, collaborative, impactful
item.description:
Authors: Jeremy Allen, Katharina Landfester, Xiaohui Qiu, Yue Zhang

Jeremy Allen, Katharina Landfester, Xiaohui Qiu and Yue Zhang introduce the future of the Nanoscale journal family: connected, collaborative, impactful.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh90042a

item.title: Coal-derived hard carbon for sodium-ion batteries: structural evolution, sodium-storage mechanisms, and regulation strategies
item.description:
Authors: Longxia Li, Shaohua Luo, Jingyi Wu, Shengxue Yan, Jing Guo, Qing Wang

Various coal precursors can be fabricated into high-performance carbon anode materials via diverse preparation and modification strategies, advancing the low-cost industrialization of sodium-ion batteries.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00293e
